How to Build a Cake Farm (Full Setup)

Cake is the only food a Breeding Farm accepts — no cake, no eggs, no breeding. Here's the full pipeline: ingredients, ranch ratios, and a starter farm blueprint.

On this page
  • The recipe
  • The 4 production lines
  • Recommended setup
  • How much cake you need
  • Common problems

The recipe (one cake)

IngredientAmountProduced by
Flour5Mill: 5 Wheat → 1 Flour (wheat from plantations)
Honey8Beegarde in a Ranch (or wild drops)
Red Berries5Berry Plantation
Milk7Mozzarina in a Ranch
Egg8Chikipi in a Ranch

The 4 production lines

1. Wheat → Flour

Plant Wheat in a Plantation, assign Planting + Watering + Gathering Pals, and run the Mill to turn wheat into flour. This is the slowest line — build it first.

2. Ranch: eggs & milk

Put Chikipi (eggs) and Mozzarina (milk) in a Ranch. One ranch building handles both — just assign the Pals to it.

3. Ranch: honey

Beegarde produces honey in a Ranch. You need 8 honey per cake, so 2-3 Beegarde are worth it.

4. Cooking Pot

Assign a Kindling Pal to the Cooking Pot. The pot auto-cooks cake as long as ingredients are in storage.

Recommended starter setup

  • 1 Wheat Plantation + Mill (with Planting/Watering/Gathering Pals)
  • 1 Berry Plantation (red berries also feed your Pals)
  • 3 Chikipi → Ranch (eggs)
  • 2 Mozzarina → Ranch (milk)
  • 2 Beegarde → Ranch (honey)
  • 1 Cooking Pot with a Kindling Pal

This supports roughly one breeding pair producing steadily. Add more ranches and a second plantation when you scale to multiple breeding farms.

How much cake you need

Each breeding attempt consumes 1 cake per egg. A breeding farm holds one pair at a time, so 1-2 cakes per in-game day per farm is a safe baseline. Keep a stock of 10-20 cakes so breeding never stalls while you're away.

Common problems

ProblemFix
Breeding Farm shows no option to breedMake sure cake is in the feedbox attached to the farm
Eggs not appearingGive the pair time; check the pair is compatible (see special combos)
Flour running outAdd another Wheat Plantation or more Gathering Pals
Cake won't cookAssign a Kindling Pal to the Cooking Pot
Next: once your cake farm runs, plan which Pals to breed with the Breeding Calculator and check exact parent pairs in the Special Combos list.
